close_reason: Created tests/integration_set_copy.rs (3 tests: set-with-params, nodeHasChildren error, copy-with-rename); bug bead JMAP-3ri9.4 filed for missing onDestroyRemoveChildren in copy; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-filenode-client/tests/integration_set_copy.rs with 3 async wiremock tests. Oracle: §3.2.3 (set params, onExists, nodeHasChildren error), §3.2.4 (copy).

**Tests:**
1. file_node_set_create_with_params: call with onDestroyRemoveChildren=true, onExists=Replace; mock returns created node; assert request body has onDestroyRemoveChildren:true and onExists:"replace". Oracle: §3.2.3 params are top-level args.
2. file_node_set_destroy_with_error: call destroy ["node-abc"]; mock returns notDestroyed {"node-abc":{"type":"nodeHasChildren"}}; assert resp.not_destroyed["node-abc"].error_type=="nodeHasChildren". Oracle: §3.2.3 nodeHasChildren error type.
3. file_node_copy_with_on_exists_rename: call with from_account_id="source-account", onExists=Rename; mock returns created node with name "report (1).pdf"; assert request body has fromAccountId=="source-account" and onExists=="rename". Oracle: §3.2.4 rename causes server to pick non-colliding name.

**Also:** File a separate bug bead flagging that file_node_copy is missing onDestroyRemoveChildren param (§3.2.4 says copy accepts same params as set). Do NOT fix the bug in this bead — just file it.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 3 tests pass. Bug bead filed.
title: Wiremock tests: FileNode/set and /copy
